title: Median Filter
text: Perform 2-D median filtering, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Padding options} sets Padding method; {Neighborhood size} sets the neighborhood window size, {Output size} sets the output sizing method Same as input, {Pad value source} sets the source of constant padding value Specify via and {Pad value}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Neighborhood size
params.values: Neighborhood window size [3 3] (default) | positive integer | two-element vector of positive integers

params.name: Output size
params.values: Output sizing method Same as input port I (default) | Valid

params.name: Padding options
params.values: Padding method Symmetric (default) | Constant | Replicate | Circular

params.name: Pad value source
params.values: Source of constant padding value Specify via dialog (default) | Input port
